key_idea: Check the three clues one at a time.
steps: The body must have a star. C has a circle, so C is out.
The eye on the right side of the picture must be a triangle. A has two dot eyes and E has the triangle on the left, so they are out.
The arm on the left side of the picture must be raised. B raises the arm on the right, so B is out.
D has the star, the triangle eye on the right and the raised arm on the left.

choice_feedback.A: Both eyes are dots. There is no triangle eye.
choice_feedback.B: The raised arm is on the right side, not the left.
choice_feedback.C: The body has a circle, not a star.
choice_feedback.E: The triangle eye is on the left side, not the right.
